title: Wisdom of LLM Crowds: Aggregation and Contamination in Language Model Ensembles
summary: This paper investigates the "wisdom of crowds" phenomenon in the context of large language model (LLM) ensembles, analyzing how aggregating judgments from multiple LLMs affects performance and potential contamination.

title: Trajectory-Aware Clinical Risk Prediction via Severity-Grounded Knowledge Graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: This research presents a method for trajectory-aware clinical risk prediction that leverages severity-grounded knowledge graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to augment Electronic Health Records with external medical knowledge.

title: Using LLMs for Explainable, Data-Driven Insight Generation from Time Series
summary: This paper explores the use of large language models (LLMs) for generating explainable, data-driven insights from time series forecasts, aiming to automate a typically manual and costly process while mitigating hallucination.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning to Master the Asymmetric Strategy of Baghchal
summary: This research applies Deep Reinforcement Learning to master Baghchal, a two-player asymmetric Nepali board game, focusing on its strategic complexity and cultural significance.

title: Operational Hallucination and Safety Drift in AI Agents
summary: This paper discusses operational hallucination and safety drift in AI agents, specifically when large language models serve as planners in tool-using autonomous agents, highlighting reliability risks in multi-turn execution.

title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report
summary: AlayaWorld presents a technical report on "video world models" that instantly generate interactive and evolving environments from user inputs, contrasting with traditional video game development.

title: Neuro-Symbolic Meta-Policies for Temporal Knowledge-Graph Memory under Partial Observability
summary: This research introduces neuro-symbolic meta-policies for temporal knowledge-graph memory in partially observable reinforcement learning, focusing on learning what information to retain, retrieve, and forget over time.

title: MAGE: Human-Like Macro Placement via Agentic Multimodal Reasoning
summary: MAGE (Macro Placement Agentic Engine) is introduced as a multimodal multi-agent framework that uses agentic reasoning to refine macro placement in industrial physical design flows through a six-phase workflow.

title: Engineering Trustworthy Agentic AI for Critical Systems
summary: This survey explores engineering trustworthy agentic artificial intelligence systems for critical domains, focusing on their autonomous perception, planning, tool use, and multi-step action capabilities.

title: Attacking Graph Foundation Models Through Their Shared Representation
summary: This research identifies the shared representation, or "alignment layer," in graph foundation models as a distinct attack surface, differentiating them from graph neural networks.

title: When Does Machine Learning Beat Value Sorting? A Three-Dataset Diagnostic of Exposure-Weighted Shipment Prioritization
summary: This research evaluates whether machine learning models can outperform simple value sorting in prioritizing shipments for review, using a three-dataset diagnostic focusing on delay-risk predictions.

title: SciHazard: A Benchmark for Measuring Scientific Safety Risks with Decomposed Harm Scoring
summary: SciHazard is introduced as a new benchmark designed to measure scientific safety risks associated with large language models, employing decomposed harm scoring to assess their potential for generating misuse guidance.

title: Semantic Primes as Explanans for Emotion in Large Language Models
summary: This research explores the use of "semantic primes" as explanations for emotion mechanisms in large language models, aiming to clarify how emotion can be understood and explained within these systems.

title: Do AI-Native Biotechs Need Departments? Benchmarking Company World Models for AI-Driven Drug Development
summary: This research proposes "Company World Models" as a new abstraction for AI-native biotechs in drug development, defining them as persistent asset-to-value state representations with planning and updating capabilities, rather than traditional agent roles.

title: DWM: Separating World Effects from Actions in Latent World Models
summary: This research introduces DWM, a method for improving latent world models by separating world effects from actions, thereby enhancing model-based control by providing a more nuanced learning signal.

title: AgentDebugX: An Open-Source Toolkit for Failure Observability, Attribution, and Recovery in LLM Agents
summary: AgentDebugX is an open-source toolkit designed to enhance failure observability, attribution, and recovery for LLM agents, providing improved debugging capabilities for complex multi-step execution errors.

title: SkillSight: Seeing Through Shared Descriptions for Accurate Skill Retrieval
summary: SkillSight proposes a method for accurate skill retrieval for large language model agents by leveraging the regular structure of skill descriptions in extensive skill libraries.

title: AI Tour Meeting: Group Travel Planning by LLM Agents
summary: AI Tour Meeting is a proposed framework for group travel planning, powered by multiple collaborative LLM-based agents, each with distinct personas, to generate itineraries through natural language discussion.

title: Evaluating medical AI under missing information: same-provider judges and human raters change apparent safety
summary: This research focuses on evaluating medical AI systems under conditions of missing information, proposing new stress-testing methods for open-ended clinical conversations using human raters to assess safety.

title: PhoenixRepair: Rethinking Repair Strategy Exploration in Software Agents
summary: PhoenixRepair proposes a new approach to enhance repair strategy exploration in software agents, addressing limitations in current agent-based methods for automated issue resolution.

title: NaviAIS: A Scenario-Level Vessel Trajectory Prediction Dataset withVectorized Lane Priors and the NaviLane Forecasting Framework
summary: NaviAIS introduces a scenario-level dataset and the NaviLane forecasting framework for vessel trajectory prediction, designed to support autonomous navigation and maritime traffic management in complex environments.

title: Black-Mamba: Biologically-Inspired Leaky Accumulation for Conceptual Knowledge under Distribution Drift
summary: Black-Mamba proposes a biologically-inspired leaky accumulation mechanism to enhance adaptive sequence models, enabling them to better process conceptual knowledge and perform forecasting under real-world distribution drift.

title: Enhancing Transformer-based Routing by Encoding Distance via Relative Positional Encoding
summary: This paper enhances Transformer-based routing by integrating Relative Positional Encoding (RPE) as an additive bias in the attention mechanism to embed pairwise spatial relationships for solving the Team Orienteering Problem.

title: OntoBook: Ontology-Grounded Synthetic Textbooks for Medical Encoder Pretraining
summary: This paper presents OntoBook, a method that converts medical ontology structures into pretraining signals for encoder language models using random walks and LLM reformulations.

title: What General Intelligence Requires: Non-Reducible Constraints Across Levels of Description
summary: This paper advances a thesis that structural constraints on general intelligence occupy distinct and mutually non-reducible levels of description, beyond just computational architecture.

title: From Dependency to Compositionality: A Neurosymbolic Lifting of LLM Outputs via Combinatory Categorial Grammar
summary: This paper proposes a neurosymbolic method using Combinatory Categorial Grammar to lift LLM outputs from dependency-based generation to a more compositional understanding of grammar.

title: Mi-Memory: A Lifecycle Memory Framework for Personal AI
summary: Presents Mi-Memory, a lifecycle memory framework designed for personal AI systems to serve as a continuity and governance substrate, preserving durable user state across various devices.

title: Fishing Out Free Riders: Shapley-Based Reward Attribution for Parallel Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper introduces a Shapley-based reward attribution method to distinguish contributions of individual reasoning paths in parallel reasoning by LLMs, aiming to prevent "free riding" in reinforcement learning.

title: Athena-Brain Technical Report: An Efficient Robot Brain for General Intelligence and Embodied Interactio
summary: This technical report presents Athena-Brain, an efficient and compact "robot brain" designed to enable general intelligence and embodied interaction for capable embodied agents, leveraging LLMs.

title: Quality Action Assurance: Multimodal Verification of Examiner Claims in VR OSCEs
summary: This paper explores multimodal verification methods to enhance quality action assurance in VR-based Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCEs) by mitigating examiner subjectivity and bias.

title: On the Effectiveness of Pretraining for Graph Combinatorial Optimization
summary: This paper introduces a self-supervised pretraining framework specifically designed to address graph combinatorial optimization problems like the Traveling Salesman Problem using graph contrastive learning.

title: Supra Cognitive Modes: A Routed Architecture for Agent Memory
summary: This paper describes Supra Cognitive Modes (SCM), a routed architecture for agent memory that maps explicit or automatically selected per-query modes to retrieval and synthesis payloads for various memory workloads.

title: OpenRTAG: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robust Text-Attributed Graph Learning under Data Quality Degradation
summary: OpenRTAG is introduced as a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating robust text-attributed graph learning models under various data quality degradations, such as sparsity, noise, and imbalance.

title: Comparative Study of Multi-Agent Actor-Critic Algorithms in Parameterized Action Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper presents a comparative study of multi-agent actor-critic algorithms, including GAC and SAC, within the domain of parameterized action reinforcement learning.

title: Beyond Single-Dimensional Compression: The Compound Sparsity Frontier of Large Language Models
summary: This paper investigates combining static parameter pruning and dynamic token-level computation to achieve compound sparsity in large language models, aiming to delay performance degradation during aggressive compression.

title: FedCC: A Low-Resource Federated Adaptation of Foundation Models for Robust Corpus Callosum localization in Fetal Ultrasound Images
summary: FedCC introduces a low-resource federated adaptation method for foundation models to robustly localize the corpus callosum in fetal ultrasound images, crucial for identifying neurodevelopmental abnormalities.

title: Compressing What Matters: Neuron Importance Meets Data-Aware Low Rank Approximation for Language Model Compression
summary: This paper proposes a language model compression technique combining neuron importance with data-aware low-rank approximation to reduce memory requirements while preserving performance.

title: Edge-Efficient Transformer for End-to-End RF Spectrum Monitoring
summary: This paper presents E-SpecFormer, an edge-efficient Transformer for end-to-end RF spectrum monitoring, introducing a new Softmax- and LayerNorm-free attention mechanism called LiTAN.

title: Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Runtime-Tunable Transit Signal Priority
summary: This paper develops a preference-conditioned multi-objective reinforcement learning approach for runtime-tunable transit signal priority, balancing objectives like reducing bus delays and minimizing impacts on other traffic.

title: BearingNAS: Obtaining In-Sensor Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Systems for Bearings Using a Laptop
summary: This paper introduces BearingNAS, a Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search (HW-NAS) framework for developing intelligent in-sensor fault diagnosis systems for bearings under extreme micro-budget constraints.

title: Multi-Timescale Latent-Action DRL for Joint Optimization in Edge-Cloud Networks
summary: This paper proposes a Multi-Timescale Latent-Action DRL approach for jointly optimizing service and resource allocation in hierarchical edge-cloud computing systems to mitigate load imbalance and improve latency.

title: SechKAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Hyperbolic Secant Functions
summary: This paper introduces SechKAN, a new Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) architecture that leverages hyperbolic secant functions to enhance its effectiveness in machine learning and scientific computing tasks.

title: Dual-domain fused LSTM modeling for efficient time-dependent reliability analysis
summary: This paper presents a dual-domain fused LSTM modeling approach for efficient time-dependent reliability analysis in engineering systems, addressing challenges in incorporating time-independent random variables.

title: Reliability Scales Inversely: Bigger Models Compound Mistakes Faster via a Hidden Auto-Regressive Risk Regime
summary: Research indicates that as language models scale, their initial answers are more accurate but degrade faster due to a hidden auto-regressive risk regime, leading to compounded mistakes.

title: One Student, Many Teachers: Multi-Task On-Policy Distillation via Soft-Prompt Privileged Context
summary: This work introduces a multi-task on-policy distillation method for large language models, allowing them to learn new skills from a teacher model that shares its backbone using soft-prompt privileged context.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for AI-Driven Crash Simulation Surrogates: A Comparative Study of Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensemble on Open-Source Bumper Beam Benchmark
summary: This study compares Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensemble methods for uncertainty quantification in AI-driven crash simulation surrogates, aiming to bridge a critical gap in their adoption for safety-critical engineering.

title: On the Limits of Support-Preserving Alignment and Bounded Filtering
summary: This research investigates the limitations of support-preserving alignment schemes and bounded safety filters in completely eliminating harmful behavior in large language models.

title: A Better Start for Language Models: Domain-Conditional Position Offsets
summary: This paper proposes using domain-conditional position offsets to improve the accuracy of autoregressive language models at the beginning of a sequence, mitigating the cold-start penalty.

title: TD-DPO: Difference-Aware Preference Optimization for Mitigating Sycophancy in Clinical Autism Intervention Dialogue
summary: This paper introduces TD-DPO, a difference-aware preference optimization method designed to mitigate the sycophancy of large language models, particularly in sensitive clinical autism intervention dialogue to reduce safety risks.

title: The Information Shadow: Measuring Structural Limits on What Language Models Can Learn
summary: This research introduces the concept of the 'information shadow' to measure structural limits on what language models can learn from text, identifying phenomena that are inherently unlearnable regardless of scale.

title: Agentic Calibration of Grey-Box Simulation Models: An LLM-Driven Alternative
summary: This paper explores an LLM-driven agentic approach for calibrating grey-box simulation models, addressing the challenges of expensive evaluations, high-dimensional parameter spaces, and plausibility constraints.

title: Spatio-Temporal Prediction of Unsteady Airfoil Aerodynamics Using Augmented Graph Neural Ordinary Differential Equations with Exogenous Controls
summary: This paper presents a method for spatio-temporal prediction of unsteady airfoil aerodynamics using augmented Graph Neural Ordinary Differential Equations with exogenous controls.

title: Interactive Training 2: Auditable Control Plane for Live Model Training
summary: Interactive Training 2 introduces an open-source control plane for auditable steering of live model training, allowing training applications to declare settings and actions through a shared protocol.

title: Cost Accounting for Reactive Computational Graphs: Exhaustive Sweeps, Sequential Mutation, and the Backward-Locality Gap
summary: This paper investigates cost accounting for reactive computational graphs, focusing on the recomputation costs associated with exhaustive sweeps, sequential mutations, and the backward-locality gap in neural network analysis.

title: Dynamic Loss Balancing for Joint SOH and RUL Prediction of Lithium-Ion Batteries via a Rotary SOH-Injected Prior Battery Transformer
summary: This research proposes a method for dynamic loss balancing for the joint prediction of State of Health (SOH) and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) of lithium-ion batteries using a rotary SOH-injected prior battery transformer.

title: Physics-Guided Masked Multi-Task Network for Edge-Friendly Battery Health Diagnostics from Sto-chastically Fragmented Charging Profiles
summary: This paper presents a physics-guided masked multi-task network for edge-friendly battery health diagnostics, enabling the prognosis of State of Health (SOH) and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) from stochastically fragmented charging profiles.

title: Federated Lightweight Fine-Tuning
summary: This research proposes a federated lightweight fine-tuning approach that addresses the communication bottleneck in federated learning by using mapping networks to generate weights from a small trainable latent space.

title: An Analysis of Residual-Stream Geometry Across Transformer Depth
summary: This paper presents a transition-centred geometric analysis of transformer residual streams, measuring relative displacement and applying orthogonal Procrustes analysis to understand representation movement across layers.

title: Multi-layer MIMO Relay as Deep Physical Neural Networks: Power Amplifiers as Activation Functions
summary: This paper proposes a deep Wireless Physical Neural Network (WPNN) architecture that embeds neural computation directly into analog hardware using multi-layer MIMO relays, with power amplifiers acting as nonlinear activation functions.

title: Physical Self-Supervised Learning: IMU Sensing without Manual Labels
summary: This research explores Physical Self-Supervised Learning for IMU sensing, aiming to overcome the limitations of costly labeled data and improve robustness across heterogeneous devices, placements, and users.

title: A Controlled Study of Attention-Only Transformers
summary: This paper presents a controlled study of attention-only transformers (Simple Attention Networks, SANs), pretraining them against standard transformers to analyze the necessity of feed-forward networks.

title: Scalable and Efficient Joint Spiking Embedding Predictive Architecture for Large-Scale Dynamic Graphs
summary: This paper introduces a scalable and efficient joint spiking embedding predictive architecture for learning patterns in large-scale dynamic graphs, with applications in areas like fraud detection and recommender systems.

title: Intelligence from Learnable Novelty
summary: This paper explores varying perspectives on intelligence across machine learning, statistics, dynamical systems, and agent-based systems, discussing its objectives and challenges in each field.

title: Estimating Rare Events in Language Models with Proper Evaluation
summary: This research proposes methods for estimating the probability of rare failures in language models, addressing challenges in quantifying risks from adversarial shifts or large-scale deployments.

title: AHEAD: Advancing Multi-Class Label Aggregation with Interpretable Cross-Annotator Modeling
summary: This paper introduces AHEAD, a framework for multi-class label aggregation that uses interpretable cross-annotator modeling to infer true labels from noisy crowdsourced annotations.

title: RRPO: Reference-Relative Policy Optimization with Stratified Conditional Rollouts
summary: This paper introduces Reference-Relative Policy Optimization (RRPO), an extension of group-relative optimization for reinforcement learning to settings beyond verifiable feedback using stratified conditional rollouts.

title: Hybrid Latent-Structural Fusion (HLSF) for Cyber Anomaly Detection
summary: This research proposes Hybrid Latent-Structural Fusion (HLSF), a novel machine learning method for cyber anomaly detection, combining tensor decomposition and normalizing flows.

title: Now We Know? A Systematic Comparison of TerraMind and THOR
summary: This study systematically compares TerraMind and THOR, two Geospatial Foundation Models, to understand the architectural and use-case specific factors influencing their performance differences in benchmarks.

title: Automated Data Engineering and Feature Selection for the Case Study of Warpage Detection in Fused Deposition Modeling
summary: This study develops an Automated Data Processing (ADP) framework for warpage detection in Fused Deposition Modeling, optimizing machine learning model-feature combinations for predictive tasks.

title: Signed Rectified Flow: Negativity-Controlled Generation
summary: This paper introduces Signed Rectified Flow (Signed RF), a new generative model that generalizes Rectified Flow to control both positive and negative distributions for generating samples.

title: Censoring-Aware In-Context Learning for Generalized Supplier Lead Time Estimation in Supply Chain Planning
summary: This research proposes a method for censoring-aware in-context learning to improve generalized supplier lead time estimation, addressing the challenges of right-censored data in supply chain planning.

title: Operational Proto-Introspection in Looped Language Models: Process-Quality Taps, Executable Branching, and the Readout-Control Boundary
summary: This research investigates operational proto-introspection in looped language models, testing whether they can assess computation quality and if external interventions based on these readouts improve outcomes.

title: Conditioned Direct Feedback Alignment via Activity and Error Geometry
summary: This paper studies conditioned direct feedback alignment (DFA), an alternative to backpropagation, analyzing its failure modes and local weight update calculation using activity and error geometry.

title: On the Diverse Dynamical Behaviors Arising in Deep Linear Transformers
summary: This research analyzes the diverse dynamical behaviors of deep linear encoder-only transformers during inference by modeling tokens as interacting particle systems.

title: Planning as Emergent Behavior in Reinforcement Learning with Relational Hidden States
summary: This paper explores how planning can emerge as a behavior in reinforcement learning systems that utilize relational hidden states, bridging the gap between model-based and model-free methods.

title: A Self-Evolving Default Action for Cooperative Tasks with Continuous Action Space
summary: This research introduces a self-evolving default action mechanism to enhance counterfactual credit assignment in multi-agent reinforcement learning for cooperative tasks with continuous action spaces.

title: BRIDGE: Bottleneck-Aware Regulator-Set Inference and Diagnosis for Cooperative Gene Regulatory Recovery
summary: This paper introduces BRIDGE (Bottleneck-Aware Regulator-Set Inference and Diagnosis), a framework designed to infer complete regulator sets for cooperative gene regulatory recovery.

title: Graph Neural Network-based Algorithm Selection for the Traveling Salesman Problem: A Systematic Study of Cost and Rank Losses under Distinct Budget Regimes
summary: This study systematically investigates Graph Neural Network-based algorithm selection for the Traveling Salesman Problem, analyzing cost and rank losses under various budget constraints.

title: Mark, Don't Erase: Token Inoculation for Dual-Use Knowledge in LLMs
summary: This paper proposes "Token Inoculation," a safety intervention method for Large Language Models to manage dual-use knowledge by marking content instead of erasing or suppressing it, aiming to preserve model competence.

title: A Classifier That Teaches Itself: Self-Improving, Frozen-gate Training (SIFT) for Dynamic Document Classification
summary: This paper introduces SIFT (Self-Improving, Frozen-gate Training), a new methodology for dynamic document classification that allows a classifier to self-improve, addressing enterprise challenges in labeling and retraining.

title: Convolution for Large Language Models
summary: This research investigates integrating lightweight depthwise convolutions into Large Language Models to provide local inductive bias, exploring an alternative to self-attention in transformer architectures.

title: Building a European Multilingual Evaluation Dataset: The MMLU Localisation Project within the EMT Network
summary: This paper describes the MMLU Localisation Project, which translates the MMLU dataset into 11 European languages to create a more inclusive multilingual benchmark for Large Language Model evaluation.

title: Relay-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Multi-Domain Reasoning Chains
summary: Introduces Relay-Bench, a new text-only benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' multi-domain reasoning chains, with GPT-5.5 (xHigh) scoring 43.3%.

title: Computational models of pragmatic reasoning with flexible generation of meaning and expression alternatives
summary: Explores computational models for pragmatic reasoning in language, focusing on how interlocutors consider alternative expressions and interpretations.

title: Using Fine-Tuned LLMs to Identify Indicators of Vulnerability in UK Police Incident Logs
summary: Investigates the use of fine-tuned LLMs to identify indicators of vulnerability within UK police incident logs, adapting an LLM-based classification pipeline developed on US data.

title: PathReportEval: A Systematic Benchmark for Pathology Report Generation
summary: Introduces PathReportEval, a systematic benchmark designed to evaluate and standardize the measurement of progress in pathology report generation from whole-slide images.

title: Structured Output Collapses Answer Diversity Across 44 Language Models
summary: A study demonstrating that requiring structured output (e.g., JSON) significantly reduces answer diversity across 44 different language models when responding to open-ended prompts.

title: Search-on-Graph-R1: Training Large Language Models to Search Knowledge Graphs with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Introduces Search-on-Graph-R1, a system that trains large language models using reinforcement learning to search knowledge graphs by exploring them via a retrieval tool for question answering.

title: Reasoning Fine-Tuning Induces Persistent Latent Policy States
summary: Investigates how reasoning fine-tuning impacts the internal mechanisms of language models, showing that it induces persistent latent policy states responsible for improved multi-step reasoning.

title: The Story Shapes the Agent: Narrative Priors in LLM Behavior
summary: A study demonstrating that the narrative framing of a task significantly influences LLM agent behavior, sometimes more than an assigned persona, using text-based investigation games.

title: For What Reason? Interpreting Models' Encoding of Causation and Antithesis
summary: Investigates how instruction-tuned Transformer models, specifically LLaMA and Mistral, encode discourse relations like causation and antithesis in English text.

title: Stochastic Meta-Unlearning: Bridging Language Backbone and Multimodal Unlearning
summary: Presents Stochastic Meta-Unlearning, a research approach to machine unlearning for vision-language models (VLMs), addressing the complexities of multimodal unlearning.

title: LatentMT: Machine Translation with Latent Reasoning
summary: Introduces LatentMT, a new machine translation system that uses latent-reasoning looped language models for recurrent computation within hidden states, offering a different scaling path.

title: Fusion Embedding: A Unified Embedding Space for Text, Image, Video, and Audio
summary: Proposes "Fusion Embedding," a method to create a unified embedding space for text, image, video, and audio, enabling a single index to serve various multimodal queries.

title: Rationale-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Cross-Lingual Stance Detection
summary: Introduces "Rationale-Guided Knowledge Distillation," a new method aimed at improving cross-lingual stance detection, a task that identifies attitudes toward a given target in text.

title: Find Before You Fine-Tune: A Diagnostic Study of Small LLMs for Cybersecurity QA
summary: A diagnostic study on small LLMs for cybersecurity question answering, investigating the trade-offs and challenges of fine-tuning them for critical domains.

title: Dual Attention Residuals
summary: Introduces "Dual Attention Residuals," a novel architectural component for Transformers that extends residual pathways along both historical retrieval and multi-stream methods.

title: RF-Agent: A Practical Framework for Building Language Agents for RFIC Design
summary: Presents RF-Agent, a practical framework designed to facilitate the building and application of language agents for radio-frequency integrated circuit (RFIC) design.

title: CASE: Causal Alignment and Structural Enforcement for Improving Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
summary: Introduces "CASE" (Causal Alignment and Structural Enforcement), a method designed to improve the faithfulness and interpretability of Chain-of-Thought reasoning in large language models.

title: AILQA: Evaluating AI-Driven Legal Question Answering Systems for the Indian Legal System
summary: Introduces AILQA, an AI-driven legal question answering system tailored for the Indian legal context, leveraging embedding and generative models, and presents a study evaluating it.

title: HPD-Parsing: Hierarchical Parallel Document Parsing
summary: Introduces HPD-Parsing, a method for hierarchical parallel document parsing that enhances unified Vision-Language Model-based parsers by combining global coordination with parallel execution.

title: From a Multilingual Streaming ASR Backbone to Kenyan-Language Systems: Data-Centric Adaptation of Nemotron 3.5 for Kikuyu, Dholuo, and Kalenjin
summary: Presents an engineering study on the data-centric adaptation of NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5's multilingual streaming ASR backbone to create systems for specific Kenyan languages: Kikuyu, Dholuo, and Kalenjin.

title: Reasoning Error from Known Fact: Step-Level Self-Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization for LLM
summary: This paper proposes a Step-Level Self-Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization method to address reasoning errors in Large Language Models (LLMs) during complex, multi-step problem solving.

title: Transcription Policy as a Latent Variable: Activating Controllable Verbatim ASR with Word-Level Timing
summary: This research explores treating transcription policy as a latent variable in ASR models to activate controllable verbatim transcription with accurate word-level timing, addressing issues of decoding instability and evaluation confounding.

title: Constrained CTC Decoding for Efficient Diacritic Restoration
summary: This work introduces a Constrained CTC Decoding method for efficient diacritic restoration in Arabic speech transcripts, leveraging speech modality to complement text-based efforts.

title: AutoJourn: Multi-Perspective Summarisation, Bias Detection and Bias Neutralisation for LLM-Generated News in Automated Journalism
summary: AutoJourn is presented as a demonstration system utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) for multi-perspective news generation, bias detection, and bias neutralization in automated journalism.

title: Disentangling Curriculum Learning in NLP: Towards a Unifying Taxonomy
summary: This paper proposes a fine-grained taxonomy to disentangle curriculum learning in Natural Language Processing (NLP), aiming to provide a principled account of difficulty functions and schedulers.

title: MedDDC-Eval: Diagnosis-Decoupled Evaluation of Multi-Turn Medical Consultation Agents
summary: MedDDC-Eval is introduced as a diagnosis-decoupled evaluation framework for multi-turn medical consultation agents, addressing the conflation of policy-elicited history and terminal diagnosis generation.

title: Computational Humor with Multimodal LLMs: Methods, Datasets, Evaluation, and Challenges
summary: This survey focuses on computational humor with Multimodal LLMs, discussing methods, datasets, evaluation, and challenges related to visual humor understanding in memes, cartoons, and comics.

title: Content is What Remains: Invariant Speech Tokenization from Parallel Utterances
summary: This research introduces a method for invariant speech tokenization from parallel utterances to better disentangle semantic from acoustic information, addressing non-linguistic variations in SSL models like HuBERT.

title: Benchmarking Human and Automatic Speech Recognition of Diverse Speech: Initial Results
summary: This preliminary study benchmarks the performance of state-of-the-art Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems against Dutch native listeners on diverse speech recognition tasks.

title: DAIS: Dependency-Aware Intermediate QA Supervision for Complex Reasoning
summary: DAIS (Dependency-Aware Intermediate QA Supervision) is introduced as a training approach to enhance complex reasoning by providing structured supervision on how local conclusions support later decisions, building on Chain-of-Thought methods.

title: Translation as Augmentation: Effect of Translated Data on Assessment of Difficulty
summary: This research investigates the effect of using translated data as an augmentation technique for the assessment of text difficulty, aiming to overcome the scarcity of expert-annotated corpora.

title: Reasoning Before Translation: Enhancing Legal Machine Translation with Structured Reasoning
summary: This work explores enhancing legal Neural Machine Translation (NMT) by integrating structured reasoning into the process, leveraging the capabilities of reasoning-capable language models.

title: MIRA-Ev:A Benchmark for Granular Evidence Detection and Relational Reasoning in Clinical Exams
summary: MIRA-Ev is presented as a new clinical benchmark for granular evidence detection and relational reasoning, improving upon existing Clinical NLP evaluation methods dominated by multiple-choice question answering.

title: Beyond Score Prediction: LLM-Based Essay Scoring and Feedback Generation via Reinforcement Learning with Rubric Rewards
summary: This study investigates using Reinforcement Learning with rubric rewards for LLM-based automated essay scoring and feedback generation, moving beyond prompt engineering and supervised fine-tuning.

title: The Price of Reasoning: Cost-Quality Tradeoffs in Reinforcement Learning for Neural Machine Translation
summary: This paper examines the cost-quality tradeoffs in applying Reinforcement Learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for the post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) in tasks like Neural Machine Translation (NMT).

title: Selection Shapes the Boundary: A Preregistered Replication of Monotonicity and Label Agreement in Unselected NLI Populations
summary: This preregistered replication study investigates the impact of selection on human label variation in Natural Language Inference (NLI) populations, focusing on monotonicity and label agreement.

title: MeetingToM: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs on Theory-of-Mind Reasoning in Multi-Party Meetings
summary: MeetingToM is introduced as an evaluation framework for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to assess their Theory-of-Mind reasoning abilities in complex multi-party meeting scenarios.

title: Inference-Time Steering for Cross-Lingual Factual Consistency in LLMs
summary: This research proposes an Inference-Time Steering method to improve cross-lingual factual consistency in Large Language Models (LLMs), addressing biases towards high-resource languages.

title: Prompt Design at Scale: How Format, Instruction Count, and Context Length Shape Instruction Adherence and Hallucination in Large Language Models
summary: This study investigates how prompt design decisions, including format, instruction count, and context length, affect instruction adherence and hallucination in Large Language Models (LLMs).

title: Two-Level Meta-Rubrics for Evaluating Open-Ended Generation: GAMUT, a Benchmark for Factual Completeness
summary: GAMUT is introduced as a benchmark utilizing two-level meta-rubrics for evaluating the factual completeness of open-ended generations from AI models.

title: Selective State-Space Adaptation and Retrieval for Language Model Reasoning
summary: This paper proposes a family of adapters that introduce selective state-space recurrence to improve language model reasoning by allowing token-level and instance-level state variation, unlike static low-rank adaptation.

title: Copy Less, Ground More: Overcoming Repetitive Copying in Long-Context Reasoning via Evidence-Aware Reinforcement Learning
summary: This research identifies "repetitive copying" as a critical failure mode in large language models during long-context reasoning and proposes an evidence-aware reinforcement learning method to overcome it.

title: Binding Drift in Multi-Step Tool-Augmented Agents
summary: This study investigates "binding drift," a failure mode where tool-augmented language model agents correctly select tools but bind them to the wrong entities during multi-step workflows.

title: A Situational Speech Synthesizer for Yoruba: System Design, Phonological Rule Architecture, and Orthographic Extensions for Contour
summary: This paper introduces TTSYoruba, a rule-based concatenative diphone speech synthesizer for the Yoruba language, which converts tone-marked Yoruba text into audio output using hand-crafted phonological rules.

title: EmoEUS: Uncertainty Supervision for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation
summary: This research introduces EmoEUS, a method for multimodal emotion recognition in conversation that addresses modality-specific uncertainty across utterances to improve recognition performance.

title: Enabling Multilingual Privacy Policy Audits: Large-Scale Analysis of Spanish Mobile Apps
summary: This research focuses on enabling multilingual privacy policy audits by conducting a large-scale analysis of Spanish mobile apps, highlighting the limitations of current English-centric auditing pipelines.

title: Hazard or Anomaly? Evaluating VLMs for Understanding Dangers and Discrepancies
summary: This paper evaluates Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for their ability to understand dangers and discrepancies in safety-critical systems, particularly in human-robot interaction contexts.

title: From Pixel to Prognosis: Convolutional and GLCM Feature Fusion for Automated Four-Class Cataract Severity Classification
summary: This research develops a low-cost automated system for four-class cataract severity classification using a hybrid framework that fuses deep features from a Convolutional Neural Network.

title: Surprise Forcing: What to Remember, When to Skip in Long Video Generation
summary: This paper introduces "Surprise Forcing," a method for long video generation that addresses the issue of bounded context and uniform resource allocation by intelligently managing what visual evidence to remember and when to skip.

title: ECoNGS: Efficient Compressive Neural Gaussian Splats for Volume Visualization
summary: This paper presents ECoNGS, an efficient compressive neural Gaussian splatting method designed for high-quality, interactive volume visualization of large datasets, addressing the explicit nature of current primitive-based methods.

title: Style over Substance: A Shortcut Audit of Emotion-Description Preference Evaluation
summary: This research conducts a "shortcut audit" of emotion-description preference evaluation, questioning its effectiveness as a standard metric for multimodal emotion understanding given its assumptions about grounded cross-modal understanding.

title: DuSPiT: Dual-Branch Sub-Patch Pixel Diffusion Transformer
summary: This paper introduces DuSPiT, a Dual-Branch Sub-Patch Pixel Diffusion Transformer, which improves image generation by operating in pixel-space to avoid information loss, addressing the limitations of existing approaches that map raw image patches to single tokens.

title: AniGS: Bridging Rendering and Diffusion Prior for 3D Scene Animation
summary: This paper presents AniGS, a method that bridges rendering and diffusion prior to enable scene-level animation for 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions, adding ambient motion to static scenes.

title: Recti-Q: Feature-Space Rectification for Out-of-Distribution-Robust Quantized Perception in Edge Robotics
summary: This research introduces Recti-Q, a feature-space rectification method designed to improve the out-of-distribution robustness of quantized perception models in edge robotics, where post-training quantization often degrades performance.

title: Physics Closure Matters for Machine Olfaction: A Maxwell--Stefan Graph Solver for Identifiable Dynamic Gas Unmixing
summary: This paper highlights the importance of physics closure for machine olfaction in gas unmixing and proposes a Maxwell--Stefan Graph Solver for identifiable dynamic gas unmixing, an underconstrained inverse problem.

title: Text-conditioned Segmentation for Tomato Phenotyping via Procedural Synthetic Data
summary: This research explores text-conditioned segmentation for tomato phenotyping, utilizing procedural synthetic data to overcome the lack of annotated training data and enable vision-based automation in greenhouse crop production.

title: Attention Without Grounding: Causal Evaluation of Visual Explanations in Medical VLMs
summary: This study conducts a causal evaluation of visual explanations generated by medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs), auditing the faithfulness of attention and saliency heatmaps to determine if they genuinely reflect the image evidence driving predictions.

title: Norm or Direction? Decoding Vision Mambas for High-Resolution Vision
summary: This research investigates Vision Mamba models and their use of selective state-space models (SSMs), comparing their performance to Gated CNN blocks for high-resolution vision tasks like image classification.

title: Seeing Before Generating: Object Perception Enhances Single-View 3D Reconstruction
summary: This paper demonstrates that incorporating learned object perception significantly enhances single-view 3D reconstruction, a challenging task in computer vision.

title: Deep Learning Estimation of Sex, Age, Height, and Weight from CT-derived Digitally Reconstructed Radiographs
summary: This study develops and validates a deep learning ensemble for estimating adult sex, age, height, and weight from CT-derived digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs).

title: Fluid-SDF: Ultra-Lightweight and Editable Implicit Shape Representation via Differentiable Primitives
summary: Fluid-SDF is a highly compressed, differentiable implicit neural representation designed for continuous 2D shape modeling. It offers an ultra-lightweight and editable solution for deploying on edge devices, addressing limitations of existing Implicit Neural Representations (INRs).

title: DeforM: Reasoning-Guided Physics-Aware Video Generation via Spatial-Temporal Masking
summary: DeforM is a novel method for reasoning-guided, physics-aware video generation, tackling the challenge of synthesizing complex deformation dynamics. It uses spatial-temporal masking to improve the physical realism of generated videos beyond what current models achieve.

title: MissingBench-Verified: Probing Vision-Language Models' Inability to Detect Missing Object Parts
summary: MissingBench-Verified is a new benchmark designed to probe Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) inability to detect missing object parts. It highlights VLMs' struggles due to real-world knowledge bias and the scarcity of such images in training data.

title: Cross-Dataset Generalization in Breast MRI Tumor Classification via Class-Wise Dataset Mixing
summary: This research investigates improving cross-dataset generalization for deep learning models in breast MRI tumor classification using class-wise dataset mixing. It aims to address issues of domain shift and dataset-origin bias that cause models to fail across different institutions.

title: Dual-Edged Homogeneous-Modality Similarity: Towards Visible-Infrared Modality-Incomplete Person Re-Identification with Modality Adaptive Matching
summary: This paper proposes a Dual-Edged Homogeneous-Modality Similarity approach with Modality Adaptive Matching for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification (VI-ReID). It addresses open-world scenarios where both homogeneous and heterogeneous modality images may be present, extending beyond closed-world assumptions.

title: Attributes Should Come from Images, Not Class Names: Distribution-Conditioned Attribute Selection for Vision-Language Models
summary: This research argues that attributes for interpretable zero-shot classification in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) should be derived from images rather than class names alone. It proposes distribution-conditioned attribute selection, showing that class name-derived descriptors often lack visual evidence.

title: Decoupled Pipeline with Proposal Reranking and Score Fusion for Positive-Unlabeled Marine Species Detection
summary: This paper proposes a decoupled pipeline using proposal reranking and score fusion for positive-unlabeled marine species detection within a competition setting. The method addresses challenges like sparse training labels and out-of-distribution test sets for underwater object detection and fine-grained classification.

title: Generative World Renderer at the Speed of Play
summary: AlayaRenderer is a generative world renderer that synthesizes RGB frames from structured world states exported from physics engines. Unlike other models, it preserves scene structure and underlying world dynamics, enabling real-time rendering at the speed of play.

title: Continual Video-MLLM Adaptation over Evolving Domains
summary: This research explores continual adaptation for video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) over evolving domains. It addresses the challenge of models acquiring new knowledge from continuously arriving heterogeneous video data in real-world deployments.

title: Weakly Supervised Pathology-Informed Representation Learning for PET-Based Content Retrieval of Intra-Tumour Heterogeneity
summary: This paper proposes a weakly supervised 18FFDG PET representation-learning framework for content-based medical image retrieval of intra-tumour heterogeneity. It utilizes H&E derived information during training while preserving PET-only inference.

title: Posterior Samplings are Missing Modalities Generators for Medical Image Translation
summary: This research proposes using posterior samplings as missing modalities generators for medical image translation, addressing the issue of incomplete multimodal acquisitions in real-world datasets. It helps provide complementary anatomical and pathological information when full multimodal data is unavailable.

title: Bounding Boxes to Improve Small Language Model Performance on Vision-Based Grading Tasks
summary: This research explores using bounding boxes to improve the performance of Small Language Models (SLMs) on complex vision-based grading tasks, such as handwritten student exams. The method aims to enhance SLMs' capabilities while maintaining privacy, cost-effectiveness, and scalability in educational settings.

title: Privileged Lesion-Context Relational Distillation for Mask-Free Skin Lesion Classification
summary: This work introduces Privileged Lesion-Context Relational Distillation (PLCRD), a new method for accurate skin lesion classification that operates mask-free during inference. It enhances clinical practicality and reduces computational complexity by removing the need for auxiliary segmentation models.

title: CGMap: A Geospatially Aware Deep Learning Framework for Crop Gap Mapping Using UAV
summary: CGMap is a geospatially aware deep learning framework designed for crop gap mapping using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery. It utilizes object detection methods to improve the accuracy of monitoring crop germination, which is crucial for estimating yield potential in India.

title: Image Editing Models are Numerical Solvers
summary: This research investigates the novel concept of using pretrained generative image-editing models as common interfaces for numerical simulation. It explores rendering physical inputs and solutions as images, with scalar quantities integrated via lightweight adapters.

title: Moving Alphabet: A Controlled Study of Training Data for Text-to-Video Generation
summary: This paper presents 'Moving Alphabet,' a controlled study examining the impact of training data on text-to-video generation models. It explores the complexities of real-world data curation, including clip selection and captioning, which often remain underexplored.

title: ZeroSplat: Generalized Referring Segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: ZeroSplat introduces a generalized referring segmentation method for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), addressing the limitation of single-target queries in existing R3DGS methods. It enables more ambiguous and real-world instructional interactions with 3D scenes.

title: In-Context Learning for Wound Classification with Small Multimodal Language Models
summary: This study evaluates the potential of small multimodal language models (SMLMs) for wound image classification through in-context learning. It explores an alternative to task-specific supervised learning, reducing the need for substantial manual labeling and retraining.

title: OPD-IAD: From Language Judgment to Industrial Anomaly Detection via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: OPD-IAD is a new method that leverages large vision-language models (LVLMs) and on-policy self-distillation for industrial anomaly detection. It aims to improve the generation of precise pixel-level anomaly maps, addressing current LVLM-based method limitations.

title: Wave2Body: Rethinking mmWave Human Pose Estimation as Radar-to-Body Token Translation
summary: Wave2Body proposes a novel approach to millimeter-wave (mmWave) human pose estimation, reframing it as a radar-to-body token translation task. It aims to recover complete 3D poses from sparse, view-dependent mmWave radar point clouds, enabling privacy-friendly human sensing.

title: Local Label-Informed Feature Transfer for Generating Ground-Truth Medical Images: A Comparison of GAN- and Diffusion-Based Approaches
summary: This research paper presents a method using GAN- and diffusion-based approaches to generate ground-truth medical images for validating Explainable AI (XAI) methods, addressing limitations of expert annotations.

title: TAP-RAG: Task-Aware Policy Control for Long-Document Multimodal Question Answering
summary: This paper introduces TAP-RAG, a system for long-document multimodal question answering that uses task-aware policy control to improve evidence retrieval beyond simple chunking in RAG systems.

title: Learning Explicit Physical Parameter Control and Benchmarking for Video Generation
summary: This research explores learning explicit physical parameter control for video generation models to achieve more physically grounded and controllable dynamics, and proposes methods for benchmarking these capabilities.

title: Dual Adversarial Fine-tuning for Enhancing Robustness of Large Vision Language Model
summary: This paper proposes a Dual Adversarial Fine-tuning method to enhance the robustness of Large Vision-Language Models like LLaVA and GPT-4V against adversarial attacks, improving their security and reliability.

title: DobicVLM: Aligning Chest X-Ray Report Generation with Clinically-Grounded Programmatic Rewards via Group Relative Policy Optimization
summary: This paper introduces DobicVLM, a vision-language model for generating chest X-ray reports, which uses supervised fine-tuning and a novel policy optimization approach for clinical accuracy and adherence.

title: SWITi: Quantifying and Reducing Tiling Artifacts with Sliding Window Inner Tiling
summary: This paper introduces SWITi, a test-time method designed to quantify and reduce tiling artifacts that arise when applying neural networks to large image data, particularly when sampling posterior distributions.

title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Approaches for AEC Engineering Drawing Layout Detection and Information Extraction
summary: This paper focuses on benchmarking deep learning approaches for layout detection and information extraction from Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) drawings, highlighting the need for specialized evaluation methods.

title: Learning Semantic-Robust Change Detection via Semantic-Invariant Self-Distillation
summary: This research introduces a method for semantic-robust change detection in remote sensing images, using semantic-invariant self-distillation to mitigate disturbances from non-semantic variations like illumination changes.

title: Mitigating Modality and Language-Style Gaps for Zero-Shot Video Moment Retrieval
summary: This research addresses challenges in zero-shot video moment retrieval by proposing methods to mitigate modality and language-style gaps inherent in existing vision-language and multimodal large language models.

title: CoGoal3D: Collaborative 3D Object Detection with 3D-Aware Fusion and Refinement
summary: This paper introduces CoGoal3D, a method for collaborative 3D object detection in V2X scenarios, which aggregates environmental features from multiple agents for improved 3D perception critical for autonomous mobility.

title: FilmWorld: Agentic Novel-to-Film Generation through Dynamic Cinematic World Modeling
summary: This paper introduces FilmWorld, an agentic system that translates novels into films by dynamically modeling a cinematic world and generating long-form, multi-scene visual narratives using generative AI.

title: Contrastive On-Policy Distillation
summary: This paper presents Contrastive On-Policy Distillation (OPD), a novel method for supervising a student model by minimizing divergence with a teacher model's output distributions on trajectories sampled from its own policy.

title: Now You See the Hate: Adaptive View Retrieval for Hidden Hateful Illusions
summary: This research highlights the failure of current multimodal safety systems and VLMs to detect hateful optical illusions and proposes Adaptive View Retrieval as a method to improve the detection of such hidden harmful content.

title: Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing
summary: This paper introduces Mage-Flow, a compact 4B-scale generative foundation model for efficient native-resolution text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing.

title: Delineate Anything v2: A Global Foundation Model for Field Delineation
summary: This paper introduces Delineate Anything v2, a global foundation model specifically designed for accurate agricultural field boundary delineation at scale, addressing limitations of general vision models in geospatial domains.

title: Context-structured Video Anomaly Detection with Large Vision-Language Models
summary: This research explores context-structured video anomaly detection using Large Vision-Language Models to improve the identification of rare and diverse abnormal events without extensive training data.

title: FARO: Feasibility-Aware Robot Motion Optimization
summary: This paper introduces FARO, a method for Feasibility-Aware Robot Motion Optimization, enabling fast planning of novel behaviors for robots, particularly in humanoid loco-manipulation scenarios.

title: Towards Torque-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Locomotion
summary: This research explores Torque-Driven Reinforcement Learning for quadruped locomotion, aiming to enhance the adaptability of legged robots to various terrain types compared to traditional position-based methods.

title: The Open Ant: A Robot Platform for Reinforcement Learning Research
summary: This paper introduces The Open Ant, a robot platform designed to facilitate Reinforcement Learning research, especially in bridging the gap between simulated and physical robotic domains.

title: Two-Stage Extrinsic Calibration of a Static Line-Scanning Lidar with a Rotary Platform
summary: This paper describes a two-stage extrinsic calibration method for a static line-scanning lidar integrated with a rotary platform, designed to enable 3D perception for industrial scanning and inspection applications.

title: STeP: Signal Temporal Logic for Precise Specifications for Action Generation with Vision Language Models
summary: This research proposes STeP, a hierarchical framework using Signal Temporal Logic (STL) to enable Vision Language Models (VLMs) to follow precise natural language instructions for action generation. It aims to improve interpretability and adherence to spatial, temporal, and logical requirements in VLA models.

title: Intelligent Multi-UAV Navigation in ITNTNs: A Hierarchical LLM Approach
summary: This paper proposes a hierarchical LLM approach for intelligent navigation and robust coordination of multiple Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in complex 3D aerial highways. It aims to provide strategic reasoning for multi-UAV systems where Deep Reinforcement Learning might fall short.

title: On the Limits of Sampling-Based Reachability: Geometry, Dynamics, and Sample Complexity
summary: This research paper investigates the fundamental limits of sampling-based reachability analysis, a method crucial for safety-critical control, robotics, and neural network verification. It explores the geometry, dynamics, and sample complexity associated with these methods.

title: End-to-end Conditional Diffusion for Realistic and Controllable Visual Traffic Scenario Generation
summary: This paper introduces an end-to-end conditional diffusion model for generating realistic and controllable visual traffic scenarios. The generated scenarios are crucial for effectively evaluating autonomous driving systems, particularly in rare and safety-critical interactions.

title: Fabric Pneumatic Artificial Muscles Based on the Drawstring Principle
summary: This paper presents an innovative design for fabric pneumatic artificial muscles that utilize the drawstring principle. These muscles aim to reduce radial deformation during axial contraction, improving efficiency for applications in robotics and industrial fields.

title: RoboInter1.5: A Holistic Intermediate Representation Suite for Embodied World Modeling and Robotic Manipulation
summary: RoboInter1.5 is presented as a holistic intermediate representation suite designed to enhance embodied world modeling and robotic manipulation. It aims to facilitate generalizable reasoning, execution, and long-horizon environment dynamics simulation for robots by providing finer-grained data annotation.

title: Confidence-Gated Vision-Only Heading Alignment for UAV-UGV Cooperative Systems
summary: This paper proposes a confidence-gated approach for vision-only heading alignment in cooperative Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and Uncrewed Ground Vehicle (UGV) systems. The method focuses on when and how a vision-based heading predictor should issue control commands for coordinated movement.

title: Correct-by-Construction Behavior Tree Synthesis from Signal Temporal Logic Specifications with Application to Robotic Missions
summary: This research introduces a correct-by-construction synthesis method for generating Behavior Trees (BTs) from Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications for robotic missions. The method aims to provide formal guarantees and address quantitative timing constraints in complex robot task execution.

title: Motion Primitive Discovery in a Humanoid Robot via Self-Organising Maps for Phase Recognition
summary: This research proposes a two-level architecture for motion primitive discovery and online phase recognition in a humanoid robot, NICO, using Self-Organising Maps. The approach is inspired by the Mirror Neuron System and aims to improve action recognition in human-robot interaction.

title: Beyond Transformers: Linear Attention Policy for Open-Vocabulary Object Goal Navigation
summary: This paper introduces a "Linear Attention Policy" that moves beyond Transformer-based architectures for Open-Vocabulary Object Goal Navigation (OVON). This new policy aims to improve internal state updates for agents operating under partial observability, enhancing their navigation performance.

title: WorldScape Policy 2.0: Empowering Steerable World Action Modeling with Reasoning-Augmented Memory
summary: WorldScape Policy 2.0 enhances World Action Models (WAMs) for robotic manipulation by empowering steerable world action modeling with reasoning-augmented memory. This new policy addresses limitations in temporal context and language supervision to improve how robots model visual state transitions and actions.

title: Design and stability analysis of an underactuated hand with passively rotating fingers
summary: This paper introduces an innovative design and stability analysis for an underactuated robotic finger with passive spatial rotation, aimed at enhancing gripping dexterity in robotic hands. The design incorporates a revolute joint to facilitate better manipulation.

title: Bayesian Retraction Optimization for Tissue Attachment Mapping in Surgical Dissection
summary: This research proposes Bayesian Retraction Optimization, a method for automating tissue attachment mapping in surgical dissection. This approach aims to improve the automation of surgical sub-tasks, particularly in the context of surgical robots.

title: Agentic Real2Sim: Physics-based World Modeling with Vision-Language Agents
summary: Agentic Real2Sim introduces a system for physics-based world modeling that utilizes Vision-Language Agents to streamline the real-to-simulation conversion process for robotic interaction. It focuses on recovering scene geometries, object states, and physical parameters to facilitate simulation.

title: Cognitive Dual-Process Planning for Autonomous Driving with Structured Scene Knowledge and Verifiable Reasoning-Action Consistency
summary: This paper proposes a cognitive dual-process planning framework for autonomous driving, emphasizing structured scene knowledge and verifiable reasoning-action consistency. The approach aims to enhance high-level planning by addressing accurate scene understanding and timely inference.

title: Computing on the Fly: Navigating a Vision for the Future of Drone Computing
summary: This report outlines a vision for the future of drone computing, forecasting a decade where drones function as a national infrastructure for moving goods, medical supplies, and information. It highlights potential applications such as rapid natural disaster detection.

title: Eversion-based robots can enable safe access,steering and endoscopic imaging within the spinal subarachnoid space
summary: This research explores the use of eversion-based robots to enable safe access, steering, and endoscopic imaging within the delicate spinal subarachnoid space. These robots aim to overcome limitations of conventional catheters by reducing friction and shear.

title: Stochastic Multi-Objective Kinodynamic Planning Against Adversaries
summary: This paper addresses stochastic multi-objective kinodynamic planning in environments with adversaries, aiming to construct a Pareto-front of paths. It focuses on trading off execution cost and safety probability when facing dynamically changing adversarial threats.

title: STL-GCS: A Planner-Controller Framework for Signal Temporal Logic via Graphs of Time-varying Convex Sets
summary: This paper introduces STL-GCS, a unified planner-controller framework for trajectory planning and control that satisfies Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications. It encodes STL tasks as time-varying convex sets in configuration space for robust control.

title: No Training, Better Flights: Test-Time Scaled VLMs for UAV Navigation
summary: This paper presents a test-time scaling method to enhance the inference performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) navigation without additional training.

title: Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling
summary: This research explores using masked visual actions to achieve unified world modeling with video models, focusing on how actions can be communicated in a visually aligned format for robotic applications.

title: RoboInspector: Unveiling the Unreliability of Policy Code for LLM-enabled Robotic Manipulation
summary: This paper unveils the unreliability of policy code generated by Large Language Models (LLMs) for robotic manipulation, despite their capabilities in reasoning and code generation.

title: TacRefineNet: Goal-Conditioned Tactile Grasp Refinement for Edge-Prominent Objects
summary: This research introduces TacRefineNet, a tactile-only, goal-conditioned framework for refining grasp alignment of edge-prominent objects, addressing challenges with sparse contacts and depth sensing.

title: Scaling Cross-Embodiment World Models for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: This paper explores scaling cross-embodiment world models to build generalist robots capable of dexterous manipulation across diverse morphologies by identifying shareable structures despite kinematic and action space differences.

title: ImplicitRDP: An End-to-End Visual-Force Diffusion Policy with Structural Slow-Fast Learning
summary: This paper presents ImplicitRDP, an end-to-end visual-force diffusion policy that integrates vision and force sensing with structural slow-fast learning for human-level contact-rich manipulation.

title: RAPT: Model-Predictive Out-of-Distribution Detection and Failure Diagnosis for Sim-to-Real Humanoid Deployment
summary: This research introduces RAPT for model-predictive out-of-distribution detection and failure diagnosis, addressing risks in deploying learned control policies from simulation to real humanoid robots.

title: Training and Simulation of Quadrupedal Robot in Adaptive Stair Climbing and Descending for Indoor Firefighting: An End-to-End Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: This paper describes an end-to-end reinforcement learning approach for training and simulating quadrupedal robots in adaptive stair climbing and descending for indoor firefighting scenarios.

title: Fly0: Persistent Metric Anchoring for Zero-Shot Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: This research introduces Fly0, a method for persistent metric anchoring in zero-shot aerial vision-language navigation, aiming to overcome control precision challenges when using Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for UAVs.

title: EquiBim: Learning Symmetry-Equivariant Policy for Bimanual Manipulation
summary: This research proposes EquiBim, a method for learning symmetry-equivariant policies for bimanual robotic manipulation, addressing the issue of inconsistent behaviors in existing robot learning methods.

title: CONTACT: CONtact-aware TACTile Learning for Robotic Disassembly
summary: This paper introduces CONTACT, a contact-aware tactile learning approach for robotic disassembly, focusing on improving manipulation reliability in contact-rich interactions where vision-based policies often degrade.

title: Fly, Track, Land: Infrastructure-less Magnetic Localization for Heterogeneous UAV-UGV Teaming
summary: This research investigates infrastructure-less magnetic localization for heterogeneous UAV-UGV teaming, enabling reliable docking and return for nano UAVs to mobile UGVs during scouting and inspection tasks.

title: TransDex: Pre-training Visuo-Tactile Policy with Point Cloud Reconstruction for Dexterous Manipulation of Transparent Objects
summary: This paper proposes TransDex, a pre-training visuo-tactile policy with point cloud reconstruction for dexterous manipulation of transparent objects, overcoming challenges like self-occlusion and depth information loss.

title: AnchorRefine: Synergy-Manipulation Based on Trajectory Anchor and Residual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: This research presents AnchorRefine, a synergy-manipulation approach for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that uses trajectory anchors and residual refinement for precision-critical manipulation tasks.

title: VOFA: Visual Object Goal Pushing with Force-Adaptive Control for Humanoids
summary: This paper introduces VOFA, a visual object goal pushing method with force-adaptive control for humanoid robots, enabling them to robustly manipulate heavy objects using onboard perception.

title: Guide, Think, Act: Interactive Embodied Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: This paper proposes GTA-VLA (Guide, Think, Act), an interactive Vision-Language-Action framework that allows users to guide robot policies with visual cues for spatially steerable embodied reasoning.
